The Denver Catholic Young Adults (DCYA) network is your hub for events and ministries that strive to bring young adults into an encounter with Jesus, His church, and authentic Christian community. We want you to meet the great people here in Denver and Northern Colorado and know Jesus Christ’s personal love for you. Whether you are just entering the Church, looking to ask questions, or hungry to grow deeper, join us! JOIN About Us Catholic Student Fellowship is the community of Catholics on campus at the University of Denver. The primary mission of CSF is to receive Jesus Christ into the hearts of its members so that through their lives and outreach, others may come to know and love Him and His Church.
